rows.name: scoped-live-stderr-alias
rows.command: { printf C; printf E >&2; } 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: scoped-capture-live-stderr-alias
rows.command: { printf "<%s>" "$(printf C; printf E >&2)"; } 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: scoped-pipeline-live-stderr-alias
rows.command: { { printf C; printf E >&2; } | cat; } 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: persistent-capture-live-stderr-alias
rows.command: exec 2>&1; printf "<%s>" "$(printf C; printf E >&2)" > result.bin

rows.name: same-file-capture-positive
rows.command: { printf "<%s>" "$(printf C; printf E >&2)"; } > result.bin 2>&1

rows.name: numeric-live-capture
rows.command: exec 3>&1; { printf "<%s>" "$(printf C; printf E >&3)"; } > result.bin

rows.name: if-live-alias
rows.command: if true; then printf C; printf E >&2; fi 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: for-live-alias
rows.command: for x in 1; do printf C; printf E >&2; done 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: c-for-live-alias
rows.command: for ((i=0;i<1;i++)); do printf C; printf E >&2; done 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: while-live-alias
rows.command: while true; do printf C; printf E >&2; break; done 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: until-live-alias
rows.command: until false; do printf C; printf E >&2; break; done 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: case-live-alias
rows.command: case x in x) printf C; printf E >&2;; esac 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: subshell-live-alias
rows.command: (printf C; printf E >&2) 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: function-return-live-alias
rows.command: f(){ printf C; printf E >&2; return 7; }; f 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: function-capture-live-alias
rows.command: f(){ printf C; printf E >&2; return 7; }; printf "<%s>" "$(f 2>&1 > result.bin)"

rows.name: nested-shell-live-alias
rows.command: bash -c 'printf C; printf E >&2' 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: input-process-substitution-live-alias
rows.command: { cat <(printf C; printf E >&2); } 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: raw-bytes-live-alias
rows.command: { cat b; cat e >&2; } 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: utf8-live-alias
rows.command: { printf 中文; printf 错误 >&2; } 2>&1 > result.bin

rows.name: numeric-swap-live-alias
rows.command: exec 3>&1; { printf C; printf E >&2; } 1>&2 2>&3 > result.bin

rows.name: pipe-captures-both-live-streams
rows.command: { printf C; printf E >&2; } 2>&1 | cat > result.bin

rows.name: nested-capture-keeps-numeric-live-alias
rows.command: exec 3>&1; printf "<%s>" "$(printf "%s" "$(printf C; printf E >&3)")" > result.bin

rows.name: root-prefix-and-tail-order
rows.command: printf B; { printf C; printf E >&2; } 2>&1 > result.bin; printf A
